_doc: 李民宪 L07 配套练习内容（培优）· 2026。主题：Unit 3 Same or Different?① 人物差异。含听力20分（独立不计入笔试）+ 阅读30 + 语言运用25 + 综合技能25 + 语法诊断20。无过去时新授测试，语法控制在 比较级-er/more·as...as·人物对比句式(Both/...but.../is more...than) 内。

transcripts: M: Is your sister outgoing?  W: Yes, she loves to talk and make new friends.
W: Tom is taller than Jack.  M: Yes, and Tom runs faster too.
W: Do you like to perform?  M: Yes, I love to sing on stage.
W: I won first prize in the contest!  M: Great! You're so hard-working.
M: I like sports and music.  W: So do I. We have a lot in common.
W: Look at the two boys in the photo.  M: Which one is your brother?  W: The taller one. He has short hair.  M: Who is the other boy?  W: He is my friend Leo. He is shorter and has a round face.
W: My best friend Ann is very outgoing.  M: Is she louder than you?  W: Yes, she talks a lot and makes everyone laugh.  M: What about you?  W: I am quieter and more hard-working. We help each other.
M: There is a talent show this Friday.  W: Are you going to attend?  M: Yes, I'll perform a dance.  W: What about your sister?  M: She will sing a song. We practice together every day.

W: The school club will have a meeting this Saturday.  M: What will we do?  W: We will plan a class party. Everyone can attend.  M: Can I help solve the problems?  W: Sure. Your ideas are always useful.  M: Great! I'll be there on time.
W: I heard you won a prize in the singing contest.  M: Yes, I got second prize.  W: That's great! How did you do it?  M: I practiced every day and my teacher helped me a lot.

Hello, everyone. Let me introduce my best friend. Her name is May. She is a hard-working student and she always solves problems in class. May is more outgoing than me, so she has many friends. In her spare time, she likes to draw and play basketball. We are different, but we have a lot in common. We both like music and we both attend the school club. I think our differences make our friendship stronger.

reading_a.provenance: 教师授权原创（2026-08-08）· 两个朋友两种风格
paragraphs: My best friends are Lily and Lucy. They are in my class, but they are very different. Lily is a shy girl. She does not talk much, and she is quiet in class. Lucy, on the other hand, is outgoing. She loves to sing and perform on stage.

Lily is hard-working. She always does her homework carefully and takes notes in class. Lucy is more creative than Lily, but she is lazy about homework. If we compare them, we can see that their differences make them interesting. Lily is better at solving problems, while Lucy is stronger at making friends.

They both attend the school club, and they help each other. Sometimes Lucy is too loud, and Lily asks her to be quiet. But they never fight. Their differences make our class more fun. I think everyone is different, and that is a good thing. My friend Li Ming is more outgoing than me. He talks a lot, but I am a quiet listener. Every day we compare our ideas and learn from each other. We are different, but we work well together.

questions.q: What is Lily like?
What does Lucy love to do?
What does the word "compare" mean in the passage?
opts: Look at how things are the same or different.

questions.q: What is the passage mainly about?

reading_b.provenance: 教师授权原创（2026-08-08）· 差异让友谊更牢固
paragraphs: People often think that good friends must be the same. But the truth is, differences can make friendship stronger. When two friends are different, they can learn from each other. For example, a shy boy can learn to be more outgoing from his brave friend. A hard-working student can help a lazy one finish the work on time.

They can also solve problems together, because each one brings a different idea. If we compare a quiet friend with a loud one, we see that the quiet one listens more and the loud one talks more. Both are useful in a team. A good friend does not have to be as outgoing as you are, or as smart as you are. What matters is that you accept each other's differences.

Some people attend a club to meet new friends, while others prefer to stay with old friends. Both ways work. In my opinion, friendship is not about being the same; it is about learning and growing together. When you respect differences, your friendship becomes stronger and more fun. We are not the same, and that is a good thing. She likes to plan everything, while I like to be free. We accept each other's differences and stay close. We learn from each other and grow stronger. Friends do not have to be the same to be true friends.

questions.q: According to the writer, what can differences do for friends?
opts: Help them learn from each other.

questions.q: What does the word "accept" mean in the passage?
Why is a quiet friend useful in a team?
opts: Because he or she listens more.
Because he or she talks more.
Because he or she is lazy.

questions.q: What is the passage mainly about?

reading_c.provenance: 教师授权原创（2026-08-08）· 校园才艺秀
paragraphs: Every year, our school holds a talent show in the gym. Students perform on stage, and the best one wins a prize. This year, my classmates and I decide to attend. We plan a short play together.

Wang Lei is hard-working and calm. He writes the play and solves many problems for us. Li Mei is outgoing and funny. She acts the main part and makes everyone laugh with her loud voice. Zhang Dan is shy, but she is very good at singing. She sings the closing song, and her quiet voice touches all of us.

We compare our ideas and choose the best one. We practice until the show day. On the night, we are nervous but happy. When we finish, the audience claps loudly. In the end, our play wins first prize. We are so proud. The teacher says our win comes from teamwork, not from one person. We learn that each person is different, and those differences work together. The talent show teaches us that when we respect each other's abilities, we can do great things. I can't wait for next year's show. Some students are good at dancing, and others are good at singing. Everyone has a special strength. We support each other on the stage. The teachers and the audience enjoy the show together. The talent show gives us a chance to show who we are. We work as a team and enjoy the night.

questions.q: What does Li Mei do in the play?
Why does the writer say their win comes from teamwork?
What is the passage mainly about?

sa.title: 阅读短文，回答下列问题或按要求完成句子
paragraphs: Lily and I are best friends. Lily is more outgoing than me, and she loves to talk and make friends. I am quieter, but I am hard-working and good at solving problems. We both like music and sports. At school, we help each other with our homework. Lily sings better than me, but I am better at drawing. Our differences make our friendship stronger. If we were the same, life would be boring.

questions.q: Who is more outgoing, Lily or the writer?
What is the writer good at?
questions.answer: He/She is good at solving problems and drawing.

questions.q: What do both of them like?
questions.answer: They both like music and sports.

questions.q: Do you think differences can make friendship stronger? Why or why not?
questions.answer: Yes, I do. Because we can learn from each other.

questions.q: 将句子 “If we were the same, life would be boring.” 译成中文。
questions.answer: 如果我们都一样，生活会很无聊。

writing.title: 书面表达（15 分）
writing.prompt: 请用英语写一篇短文，比较你和一位朋友在性格、兴趣或能力方面的异同，至少使用一句 Both... 和一句 ...is more...than。
writing.requirements: 1. 使用本课词汇与句型（比较级、as...as、Both.../...but.../...is more...than）；2. 80 词左右；3. 条理清楚，语句通顺，句式有变化。
writing.sample: My best friend is Mike. We are good friends, but we are different. Mike is more outgoing than me, and he loves to talk. I am quieter, but I am hard-working. We both like sports and music. Mike is better at playing basketball than me, but I am better at drawing. We help each other with our homework. Our differences make our friendship stronger. I am happy to have a friend like him.

grammar_diag.title: 语法诊断（比较级·as...as·人物对比句式）

questions.q: Tom is ___ than me.
Lucy is ___ outgoing than her sister.
I am ___ tall as my friend.
___ Lily and Lucy are outgoing.
He is not ___ loud as his brother.
用所给词的适当形式填空：My friend runs (fast) ___ than me.
用所给词的适当形式填空：She is (hard-working) ___ than her brother.
用所给词的适当形式填空：He is (lazy) ___ than before.
用所给词的适当形式填空：I am as (tall) ___ as Lucy.
用所给词的适当形式填空：Tom is (quiet) ___ than before.
